title: Calibration Rod

view_strategy.reason: P001 is a solid rod with no internal geometry requiring a section; use the longitudinal profile plus one end view for the non-axisymmetric anti-rotation feature.

interface_end_views.reason: Anti-rotation feature is not fully communicated by the longitudinal profile alone.

characteristics.spec: Current CAD major cylinder Ø4.00; male-thread axial length 3.50 mm nominal. Functional M4 bottoming chain exists, but production pitch/class and length tolerance remain OPEN.
1.00 mm current native-CAD axial tip segment
Feature is present in current native CAD on the 27 mm working-shaft segment; final cross-section dimension/tolerance is OPEN and shall not be invented in the drawing.

release_blockers: P001 Product Definition is not manufacturing-complete: datum reference frame is not released.
P001 guide/axial production tolerances are not released, including the Ø5 guide function and axial chain.
P001 male M4×0.7 shoulder/thread class and manufacturing acceptance are not fully released.
P001 anti-rotation feature required over X38..57 is not dimensionally/inspection-defined in the drawing authority.
P001 Optical Target Datum / target-surface acceptance is not released.
P001 straightness/runout and gas-wetted/guide surface-finish or polish acceptance are not released.
Drawing title-block/projection-symbol template layer remains manual-finish/D9 controlled.
review_notes: HOLD — PRODUCT DEFINITION INCOMPLETE. DO NOT USE AS MANUFACTURING DRAWING.
The prior D001 generic build is retained only as Drawing System evidence; it is not an acceptable K01-D-001 drawing.
Required minimum content is controlled by K01_PROJECT_CONTROL Drawing Content/Build Queue and the A001 functional interfaces.
Do not rebuild D001 until authoring_readiness becomes READY_FOR_AUTHORING.

annotations.text: M4 FUNCTIONAL MALE INTERFACE — CURRENT CAD MAJOR Ø4.00 / L=3.50 NOM; PRODUCTION PITCH/CLASS/TOLERANCE OPEN

automation_scope.rule: The API authors only dimensions/symbols that have stable direct B-rep or already-proven semantic bindings. Sketch-only segmentation, inferred virtual shoulders, and unsupported presentation details are preserved as review notes/manual-finish work instead of blocking the entire drawing build.
manual_fallback_on: characteristic has no stable B-rep boundary
sketch-only segment is not represented by a physical edge/face

authoring_readiness.reason: The 2026-09-16 generic build proved file/control plumbing but not manufacturing-definition completeness. Drawing authoring is blocked until the minimum controlled content for P001 is defined and verified against native CAD and A001 interfaces.

collar geometry and its functional axial reference
overall length 68.50 and controlled axial chain
M4 shoulder at X65 and male M4×0.7 L3.50 manufacturing definition
anti-rotation flat/feature over X38..57 with actual cross-section dimension, orientation and tolerance
Optical Target Datum and target-surface acceptance
functional datum reference frame derived from P002/P004 guidance, P008 threaded interface and anti-rotation function
straightness/runout/coaxiality requirements where required by the guide function
surface roughness/polish requirements on guide/gas-wetted/optical-relevant surfaces
material EN 1.4404 / AISI 316L and manufacturing/inspection notes
known_from_existing_control: male M4×0.7 L3.50 required by Drawing Content/Build Queue
anti-rotation feature location X38..57 required by Build Queue
Optical Target Datum required by Drawing Content
